description.short_caption: H&E stain of breast tissue showing dense neutrophilic infiltrate surrounding a cystic area.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image, stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), shows breast tissue at 40x magnification. There is a dense infiltrate of neutrophils surrounding a cystic area, consistent with an inflammatory process. The epithelial lining appears disrupted, and the surrounding stroma shows evidence of acute inflammation. The image highlights the cellular details and inflammatory response.

Case_17019/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Ultrasound image of left breast mass

description.short_caption: Ultrasound image of a left breast mass.
description.detailed_description: This ultrasound image shows a hypoechoic, irregularly shaped mass in the left breast, located at the 9 o'clock position. The lesion measures approximately 3-4 cm in length and exhibits posterior acoustic shadowing, which may suggest a solid lesion. The surrounding breast tissue appears heterogeneous. The orientation and labeling confirm the left breast as the site of interest.
visible_findings: labeled as left breast, 9 o'clock position

description.short_caption: Breast biopsy, H&E stain at low magnification showing granulomatous inflammation.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image, stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) at low magnification (4x), shows a central area of necrosis surrounded by granulomatous inflammation. The necrotic center appears pale and amorphous, while the surrounding tissue demonstrates a rim of inflammatory cells, including epithelioid histiocytes and possible multinucleated giant cells. The architecture suggests a granulomatous process, potentially infectious or non-infectious in etiology.
